aboutText: Ring Road Auto Electrical is a highly professional business with over 25 years of experience in the auto electrical industry. We have worked across all parts of Australia, gaining extensive industry knowledge. Based in Ravenhall beside the Ring Road and Deer Park Bypass, we are strategically located in the heart of Melbourne's warehousing and distribution hub, close to the airport and ports for efficient service.
servicesText: Ring Road Auto Electrical provides a full range of auto electrical services, including diagnostics, repairs, and mobile solutions. Based in Ravenhall, we serve Melbourne's west with our 25 years of expertise, ensuring your vehicle's electrical system is in top condition.

services.title: Auto Electrical Diagnostics
services.desc: We provide comprehensive auto electrical diagnostics using state-of-the-art equipment to accurately identify faults and recommend effective solutions for your vehicle.

services.title: Battery Replacement & Charging
services.desc: Our battery services include testing, replacement, and charging system repairs, ensuring optimal performance and longevity for your vehicle's power source.

services.title: Alternator Repairs
services.desc: Specializing in alternator repairs and replacements, we ensure your vehicle's charging system operates efficiently to power all electrical components.

services.title: Starter Motor Services
services.desc: From starter motor diagnostics to full replacements, we deliver reliable services to get your vehicle started without issues.

services.title: Wiring & Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Expert wiring repairs and electrical system enhancements are tailored to your vehicle's needs, using quality parts and techniques.

services.title: Mobile Auto Electrical Service
services.desc: As a mobile service, we come to you in Ravenhall and nearby areas, offering convenient and professional auto electrical assistance.
